1409-2741-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Essence Warden trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

141-2511-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2511-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-5254-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
2292-5254-8122.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
2292-5254-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1746-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Accomplished Automaton.
When Accomplished Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Accomplished Automaton enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

223-5941.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{R} plus the cost of the additional sorcery
223-5941.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional castable sorcery.
223-5941.description:
Cast any sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Wild Ricochet by paying its mana cost.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Wild Ricochet and choosing to copy the original Wild Ricochet.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Wild Ricochet copy, creating a copy of Wild Ricochet.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.

1651-3715-5365-7803.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
1651-3715-5365-7803.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

1563-2457-7060-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3668-3908.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3668-3908.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Flesh Duplicate each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3668-3908.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

4644-4747-7791.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 2 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
4644-4747-7791.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Alena.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Alena.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three loyalty counters on it

413-598-5173.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
Shambing Ghast dies, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Shambling Ghast enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

38-978-6972.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat.

4050-6073-7495-7498.description:
Cast a copy of All Aboard by paying {U}, blinking Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it and Angelic Sell-Sword trigger.
Resolve the Biblioplex Tomekeeper trigger, preparing Skycoach Conductor.
Resolve the Angelic Sell-Sword trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {U}.
Repeat.

3605-4050-4812-6553.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4687-5704-6287.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with power 4 or greater.
4687-5704-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Leafkin Avenger.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.

1618-2056-2440-3019.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Saheeli, Sublime Artificer
1618-2056-2440-3019.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Saheeli, Sublime Artificer triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.
1618-2056-2440-3019.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Saheeli, Sublime Artificer. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

654-2893-3875-4136.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Amulet of Vigor.
When the basic land enters, Amulet of Vigor, Tireless Provisioner and Roaring Earth trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

767-3525-6702--119.description:
Tap Kilo using any free method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and putting a charge counter on Druids' Repository.
Activate Druids' Repository by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.
767-3525-6702--119.notes: This combo will also give you infinite results from whatever method you use to tap Kilo.

560-2457-4365-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Soldier and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2866-3689-3836-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-5256-6476.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-5256-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

4120-4968-5429.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat as desired.
4120-4968-5429.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

2034-2653-5478-5552.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten permanents.
2034-2653-5478-5552.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation and untapped due to Spelunking.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

2492-2845-3556-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
2492-2845-3556-4423.description:
Cast Bonus Round by paying {1}{R}{R}, causing each player to copy each instant or sorcery spell they cast this turn.
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Mystic Sanctuary.
Bonus Round triggers, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the copy of Flicker, blinking Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Quintorius Kand's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to exile Flicker from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost, targeting Mystic Sanctuary.
Quintorius Kand and Bonus Round trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius Kand trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Bonus Round trigger, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Repeat from step 4.

1734-2034-2150.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter, adding {C}{C}.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes to the battlefield from exile.
When Hero of the Dunes enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Repeat.

609-1185-1816-4222-4898.notablePrerequisites:
Prize Pig and Mine Worker do not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Mine Worker.
609-1185-1816-4222-4898.description:
Activate Mine Worker by tapping it, causing you to gain three life.
Prize Pig triggers, putting three ribbon counters on it, then removing all ribbon counters on it and untapping it.
Activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Mine Worker.
Repeat.

1424-1486-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura and Presence of Gond attached to Magda.
Magda does not have summoning sickness.
1424-1486-3525.description:
Activate Magda by tapping it.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Magda's ability, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat.

2724-3217-3504.description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender for {4}{U}, entering as a copy of Wormfang Manta.
Pay {2}{U}{U} to return it to your hand, triggering Wormfang Manta's LTB, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Repeat for infinite turns.

1436-3088-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
1436-3088-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-3088-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

618-1536.description:
Activate the mutated Insatiable Hemophage and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.
